prompt:
Locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan. The three people stand in single file inside the blue-rope lane, facing frame left toward the wooden counters: the woman in the mustard coat with the white kettle at the front, the pensioner in the lilac coat with the small fan in the middle, the red-haired lad in the grey hoodie nearest the camera on the right, eyes on his phone. The woman at the front glances up toward the red number display, then takes one small step forward at about two seconds; the pensioner follows half a beat later with a small step of her own; the lad notices the gap a moment after that and shuffles one step forward without lifting his eyes from the phone. They come to rest a step further along the lane and go on waiting patiently, the pensioner giving a small sigh through closed lips. Nobody speaks. The red display keeps showing the digit 3 and every POWER sign keeps its exact letters. Same three people, same hall, same light throughout.
Natural documentary realism, overcast daylight.
Thanks.
